reddit.title: Introducing a New Materials System in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update in Provincia! Instead of a single cost badge for build tiles, you can now see a detailed **Materials** sheet for each entry. This allows you to easily track what's stored versus what's required, with any shortages clearly highlighted. This change enhances your building experience, ensuring you're always informed about your resource needs. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: New Materials Management Update
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce a new update that changes how you manage resources in Provincia! Build tiles will now display a materials sheet that shows stored versus required resources, with any shortages clearly marked. This improvement simplifies your building strategy and enhances gameplay. For more information, check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
